privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.body:
## who-we-are | Who we are

This Privacy Policy explains how {store}, headquartered in Kotdwara, Uttarakhand, India, handles personal information collected when you use this online store.

Business name and address: {legalName}, {address} (GSTIN {taxId}).

## information-we-collect | Information we collect

We collect the information you provide when you create an account, place an order or update your details:

- Your name, email address and phone number.
- Billing and delivery addresses, including any addresses you save to your account.
- Order details, such as the products, pack sizes, quantities and amounts of your orders.
- Your account sign-in details. Passwords are handled by our commerce platform and are not visible to us in readable form.

Payment card and bank details are entered on the secure form of the payment provider shown at checkout. This website does not store your card details.

## how-we-use-information | How we use your information

- To process, pack and deliver your orders, and to show you your order history and status.
- To create and manage your account, including email verification and password resets.
- To contact you about your orders.
- To meet our legal, tax and accounting obligations.

## cookies-and-storage | Cookies and browser storage

The store keeps a small amount of information in your browser so it works properly:

- A session token in your browser's local storage, which keeps your cart and sign-in active between visits.
- A cookie that remembers your selected currency.

You can clear these at any time in your browser settings; doing so will sign you out and may empty your cart.

## sharing | How we share information

We share personal information only as needed to run the store and fulfil your orders:

- Payment providers, to process your payment.
- Delivery partners, to deliver your order.
- Service providers that host and operate this store on our behalf.
- Authorities, where we are required to by law.

We do not sell your personal information.

## retention | How long we keep information

We keep your information for as long as your account is active and as needed to fulfil orders and meet legal obligations, such as tax and accounting record-keeping. You can ask us to delete your account information at any time (see "Your choices").

## your-choices | Your choices

You can view and update your profile and saved addresses at any time from your account. To request a copy or deletion of your personal information, contact us using the details below.

## security | Security

We take reasonable measures to protect your information. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security.

## changes | Changes to this policy

We may update this policy from time to time. The date at the top of this page shows when it was last revised.

## contact | Contact and grievances

For privacy questions, requests or complaints, contact {legalName}: email {email} or WhatsApp {phone}. Postal address: {address}.

terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.body:
## about-these-terms | About these terms

These terms apply when you browse or buy from the {store} online store. By placing an order you agree to them. This store is operated by {legalName}, {address} (GSTIN {taxId}).

## accounts | Your account

You can check out as a guest or create an account. If you create an account, you are responsible for keeping your sign-in details secure and for activity under your account. Please keep your contact and delivery details accurate.

## products-and-prices | Products, prices and availability

- Prices are shown in the currency displayed in the store and include applicable taxes as shown at checkout.
- Available pack sizes and stock are shown on each product and may change. If an item becomes unavailable after you order, we will let you know.
- We aim to describe and display products accurately. If we make an obvious pricing or listing error, we may cancel the affected order and refund any payment made.

## orders-and-payment | Orders and payment

Your order is placed when you complete checkout and your payment is confirmed. Payment is processed securely by the payment provider shown at checkout, using the payment methods available for your order.

## shipping | Shipping and delivery

The delivery options available for your address, with their charges, are shown at checkout before you pay. If no delivery option is offered for an address, we cannot currently deliver there. For questions about a delivery, contact us with your order number.

## cancellations-returns-refunds | Cancellations, returns and refunds

If there is a problem with your order, such as a damaged or incorrect item, contact us with your order number (email {email} or WhatsApp {phone}).

Cancellation, return and refund policy: [[To be confirmed by {store}: cancellation window, return eligibility and refund method and timelines]].

## use-of-the-store | Using the store

Please use the store only for lawful purposes. Do not attempt to interfere with its operation, access other customers' information, or misuse its content.

## intellectual-property | Intellectual property

The {store} name, logo, product images and other content on this store belong to {store} and may not be used without permission.

## liability | Limitation of liability

Nothing in these terms limits any rights you have under applicable consumer law.

## governing-law | Governing law

These terms are governed by the laws of India.

## changes | Changes to these terms

We may update these terms from time to time. The version in force when you place an order applies to that order.

## contact | Contact

Questions about these terms or your order: email {email} or WhatsApp {phone}. Postal address: {address}.
